title: Run frame-driven visual QA
description: Verify implemented states against source frames with browser evidence.
objective: Prove visual fidelity, responsive behavior, and admin usability before marking implementation tasks done.
acceptance_criteria: Each completed state has desktop screenshot evidence.
Mobile/tablet layout has no incoherent overlap or page-level horizontal overflow.
Console has no relevant JS errors.
Any frame divergence is documented as intentional or unresolved.
Visual tasks are not marked done without screenshot evidence.

budgets.time_budget: one QA pass per state group
budgets.validation_budget: human validation if visual source conflict remains

risks: Lint/render checks alone can falsely pass a visual implementation.
WordPress admin chrome may shift pixel expectations from generated frames.

tests.objective: Verify frame-16 (Filter Controller Preview Modal) against the implemented Admin V0.2 state.
preconditions: Source frame exists at docs/assets/implementation-toolkit/admin-v0.2/frames/frame-16.png.
Local WordPress admin implementation for the corresponding state is reachable.
TASK-006 or TASK-007 has implemented the state.
steps: Open the matching WordPress admin state.
Capture desktop screenshot.
Capture responsive screenshot when layout behavior is in scope.
Check browser console for relevant errors.
Compare against source frame and record frame-drift notes.
tests.expected_result: Implementation preserves controller-only modal, no listing/grid and remains inside the WordPress-contained Toolkit shell.
pass_criteria: source frame reference is recorded
desktop screenshot exists
no relevant console errors are present
no incoherent overlap or page-level horizontal overflow is present
drift notes are documented as accepted, fixed, or blocked
